title: How Far from Clinical Deployment? Evaluating the Complete Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Pipeline in Medical Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2608.12035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) in clinical practice requires choosing which algorithm to use and which of its trained models to ship. However, the deployment (target) domain is unlabeled, so models cannot be evaluated directly on it, leaving it unclear which to select. We address this by evaluating the complete UDA pipeline, considering both adaptation and label-free selection together. Our study covers eleven clinically relevant cross-domain scenarios from nine medical imaging datasets, with ten UDA algorithms and 13 label-free selection methods (validators), evaluating over 80,000 trained models in total. By this, we find that a capable adapted model usually exists, but identifying it without target labels is difficult: the validator-selected models leave a large and structural target performance gap to the best available one, with no evaluated validator consistently reliable. translated_title: 距离临床部署还有多远？评估医学影像中完整的无监督域适应流程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12035v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在临床实践中部署无监督域适应（UDA）需要选择使用哪种算法以及交付其训练模型中的哪一个。然而，部署（目标）域是无标签的，因此无法直接评估模型，导致选择不明确。我们通过评估完整的UDA流程来解决这个问题，同时考虑适应和无标签选择。我们的研究涵盖了来自九个医学影像数据集的十一个临床相关跨域场景，涉及十种UDA算法和十三种无标签选择方法（验证器），总共评估了超过80,000个训练模型。通过此，我们发现通常存在一个能力强的适应模型，但无目标标签时识别它很困难：验证器选择的模型与最佳可用模型之间存在较大且结构性的目标性能差距，且没有评估的验证器始终可靠。为缩小这一差距，我们探索了两种策略。
tldr: 本研究全面评估了医学影像中无监督域适应的完整流程，发现尽管存在高性能适应模型，但无标签选择方法难以可靠识别它，导致临床部署面临重大性能差距。
en_tdlr: This study comprehensively evaluates the complete unsupervised domain adaptation pipeline in medical imaging, finding that while capable adapted models exist, label-free selection methods struggle to reliably identify them, leaving a significant performance gap for clinical deployment.
